title: Fourier coefficient of the binary inner product
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every pair of binary vectors $\gamma$ of length $2n$, the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the sign encoding of the mod-two inner product between the two length-$n$ blocks is $2^{-n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is a binary vector of length $2n$
